purpose: Teach: セキュリティー/書き込む/宝くじ/猛烈/若しくは/つかみ/近々/なんだかんだ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお家のセキュリティーを点検されてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was checking the home security system earlier.
lines.style: Warm observation, like noticing something small that mattered. Gentle, almost fond. No urgency. Trailing warmth at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵日記に毎日書き込むよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to write in my picture diary every single day!
lines.style: Bright declaration with genuine excitement. Earnest emphasis on 'every single day' — he means it. Quick pace, unguarded energy. Like sharing a promise he just made with himself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが宝くじを子供と一緒に観るのが好きなのよ
lines.en: Sho, I think your dad really loves watching the lottery drawing with you.
lines.style: Gentle insight. Soft, reflective tone. Not stating a fact but offering something she's observed and found sweet. Slight pause before the observation, like she's thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、夏は猛烈に汗かくよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I sweat really a lot when summer comes.
lines.style: Simple statement of fact, without self-consciousness. Matter-of-fact delivery but not dismissive of himself. The honest observation of a child. Quick and direct.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、アイス若しくはジュース、どっちにする?
lines.en: Sho, would you like ice cream or juice?
lines.style: Calm, practical question. The tone of someone offering a small kindness. Even pace, attentive — she's genuinely curious which he'd prefer. No pressure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの腕をつかみ歩くよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to hold Dad's arm when we walk.
lines.style: Soft, almost tender declaration. Gentle emphasis on the arm-holding — it matters to him, but he says it simply. Unhurried. Like sharing something quietly precious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、近々、お祖父ちゃんとお祭りに行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go to the festival with Grandpa soon, all right?
lines.style: Warm invitation with gentle certainty. Pleasant, looking-forward tone. Slight lift at the end — a soft promise wrapped in care. No doubt in her voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、なんだかんだで今日は嬉しい一日だったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, somehow today ended up being a really happy day.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective closing. Quiet realization in his voice — he's noticing the happiness as he says it. Warm, genuine, no rush. A small moment of contentment.
